introduction: Nevada 211 connects residents with community services. Specialists operate Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Pacific, excluding holidays; the searchable directory remains available outside those hours.
description: Nevada 211 connects residents with community services. Specialists operate Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Pacific, excluding holidays; the searchable directory remains available

sections.who: Anyone seeking resource information can contact the service. Each referred organization decides its own eligibility and whether assistance is available.
sections.get: Free, confidential referrals cover needs such as food, housing, utilities, transportation and childcare.
sections.docs:
• Your ZIP code or county.
  • A description of the need and any urgent date.
  • Contact details and notes from agencies already approached.
sections.apply:
1. Contact a specialist

    Dial 211 or 866-535-5654, or text your ZIP code to 898211.

  2. Explain what you need

    Use the contact page for chat and other options.

  3. Follow the referral

    Ask the receiving provider about eligibility, intake hours and documents before visiting.
sections.after: Request alternatives if a referral cannot help. The directory is useful when specialists are unavailable, but a listing does not confirm that funding is open.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Nevada 211 service and hours, Contact options. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is the specialist service available all night?
No. Current published hours are weekdays 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Pacific, excluding holidays.
Can I text rather than call?
Yes. Send your ZIP code to 898211.
It provides referrals; the receiving organization makes assistance decisions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
